g.text: Independent active-loop mismatch reset; no software arm or override

g.desc: Independent active-loop mismatch reset; no software arm or override

g.text: Closed loop: C=D => no reset. Open/stuck/grounded loop: mismatch pulses feed RC and hard reset.

g.desc: Closed loop: C=D => no reset. Open/stuck/grounded loop: mismatch pulses feed RC and hard reset.

g.text: U24 OE and function straps are fixed copper, not GPIO. No host bypass or software mask.

g.desc: U24 OE and function straps are fixed copper, not GPIO. No host bypass or software mask.

g.text: U27 Ioff limits feed into unpowered main logic; leakage is not zero. No maximum input slew at U27/U25.

g.desc: U27 Ioff limits feed into unpowered main logic; leakage is not zero. No maximum input slew at U27/U25.

g.text: Active TAMP hardware, backup anchor and fresh secure readback remain mandatory; XOR alone is insufficient.

g.desc: Active TAMP hardware, backup anchor and fresh secure readback remain mandatory; XOR alone is insufficient.

g.text: Probe bridging, matched waveform injection and short glitches are residual risks requiring lab tests.

g.desc: Probe bridging, matched waveform injection and short glitches are residual risks requiring lab tests.

g.text: Powered/unpowered transitions, input thresholds, reset propagation and backup life NOT qualified.

g.desc: Powered/unpowered transitions, input thresholds, reset propagation and backup life NOT qualified.
